d.ko: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.
d.en: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.
d.zh: 一款程序化的合作太空沙盒游戏，玩家可以用动态可伸缩的方块建造自己的太空舰船。经历史诗般的太空战斗、探索、采矿、交易、发起战争、建立自己的帝国，从未知敌人的手中拯救你的宇宙。
